earlier_passes: the drill was run five times in all (an always run then an off run each time) on the same repository, with the tooling corrected after each independent review and after each real-flow launch the stricter checks flagged; the first pass, the only one whose setup pushed to the empty default branch, and every later pass passed A1 to A5 once the checks matched what the flow legitimately does; the runs reported here are the last pass, made with the final tool. Each pass left its own goal issue, PR and sdlc branch on the drill repository for the owner to delete with it.
measured_note: the flow under test (skills/) is exactly this commit's tree; the drill tooling in tools/readiness was uncommitted at measurement time and ships in the PR that adds this file

observations.a3_run2: run 2 deletes nothing, so its A3 passes on zero deletes and an unchanged branch set, not on an exercised delete
does_not_show: a scripted flow is not a model-driven run
the merge path has no branch-identity guard (issue 351); the drill reports what it did and does not prove a guard
the capture sees Python subprocess launches only: shell-form launches are counted, not classified, graphql mutation targets are invisible, and a wrapper program is recorded by name only
a force-push of the default branch away from the baseline tip and back to it, with the feed carrying no PushEvent, is invisible to A1 to A4; only A5, through the capture, can see it
A5 trusts the remote name origin; the driver's origin guard runs before the PR and merge steps, not around every launch
A5 compares rule categories plus verbs and targets, not code sites
gh api launches with the literal {owner}/{repo} placeholder resolve through GH_REPO and the origin guard, which the capture cannot show
a branch created and deleted inside the window with no PR, whose DeleteEvent the feed dropped, would be seen only by the capture's endpoint allowlist
observations.events_feed: the repo events feed is intermittent and its shape differs from the documented one: the three pushes of the first pass produced no PushEvent (branch creations appeared as CreateEvent) while later passes did record one; a merge appeared as PullRequestEvent with action 'merged' and a stub pull_request (base.ref and number only); one real deletion of an sdlc/ branch (PR head_ref_deleted on the timeline, ref gone from matching-refs) produced no DeleteEvent at all. A1 to A3 therefore rest on the pulls list, the timeline, the branch's own compare from the baseline tip to the final tip and matching-refs; the feed is extra evidence, and what it delivered is in each run (push_events_seen, delete_events_in_feed, head_ref_deleted_events).
observations.legitimate_writes_seen: issue create and comment, label create, gh api POST pulls, gh pr comment and merge, gh api DELETE of the sdlc/ branch, git push of the sdlc/ branch (and once of the default branch, in the first pass only), graphql lifecycle label-swap mutations (counted: the capture cannot see their target), local git config core.hooksPath and sigma.* keys in the scratch clone, git -c overrides that only disable settings (core.hooksPath to an empty directory, diff.external empty)
